## `client.checks`

Read the results of the data quality checks a run made.

### `client.checks.for_run`

Signature: `client.checks.for_run(environment: str, run_id: str) -> list[CheckResult]`

List the check results of one run (needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT` or `RUN`).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `run_id` | `str` | required | The run. |

Returns: `list of CheckResult`. By task, then by check name.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the run does not exist in this environment. |
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If the caller may not read the run. |

### `client.checks.rows`

Signature: `client.checks.rows(run_id: str, check: str, *, environment: str) -> QueryRun`

Queue the query that shows the rows a check found in a run.

The rows are shown as they were then, also after the table was set back. The query is an ordinary query of yours: it runs the check's SQL under your own rights, row filters and column masks, and reads the checked table at the snapshot the check read. Wait for it and fetch the rows with the handle: `.wait()`, then `.result()`.

Needs the right to read the run (`RUN` or `READ_ENVIRONMENT`) and `SUBMIT_QUERY`. The rows can be read for seven days after a failed blocking check; then table maintenance removes the snapshot.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | `str` | required | The run. |
| `check` | `str` | required | The check as `lakana check list` shows it: ``&lt;namespace&gt;.&lt;table&gt;/&lt;check&gt;``. |
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |

Returns: `QueryRun`. The handle of the queued query, as `client.queries.submit` returns it. A query that cannot be answered (the snapshot is gone, the table is not shown to you) ends `FAILED`; `.wait()` raises `lakana.errors.QueryFailed` with the reason.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the run does not exist in this environment, or has no result for the check. |
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If you lack the right to read the run or to submit queries. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If the check read no snapshot, so there are no rows to show, or the run's project version no longer holds the check's SQL. |

### `client.checks.list`

Signature: `client.checks.list(environment: str, *, table: str | None = None, limit: int = 50, cursor: str | None = None) -> CheckResultPage`

List one page of an environment's check results, newest first (needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`).

The filter is not part of the cursor: pass the same `table` with every page. `iter` does this for you.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `table` | `str | None` | `None` | Only this table's results (dotted name). |
| `limit` | `int` | `50` | Results per page, between 1 and 200 inclusive. |
| `cursor` | `str | None` | `None` | A previous page's `next_cursor`, to fetch the page after it. |

Returns: `CheckResultPage`. Up to `limit` results, and the cursor for the next page.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If the caller may not read the environment. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If `limit` is out of range or `cursor` is not one the server issued. |

### `client.checks.iter`

Signature: `client.checks.iter(environment: str, *, table: str | None = None, page_size: int = 50) -> Iterator[CheckResult]`

Yield every check result of an environment, newest first, fetching pages as needed.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `table` | `str | None` | `None` | Only this table's results (dotted name). |
| `page_size` | `int` | `50` | Results per request, between 1 and 200 inclusive. |

Yields: `CheckResult`. Each result, once.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If the caller may not read the environment. |
